00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000015.title: Father Quill
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000015.synopsis: The bell ringer, though there has not been a priest on Bellwether in fifty years. Rings the tower bell whenever the island moves.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000015.notes: Comic on the surface. He is the only islander who has made peace with forgetting.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000016.title: Nan Hollis
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000016.synopsis: Keeps the only shop in the harbor village and the island’s unofficial record of who has forgotten what.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000016.notes: The gossip who is always accurate. Use her to deliver information Elin will not.
